t: Fortress 10Ltr Smooth White Masonry Paint provides a durable, smooth finish for external walls. This high-performance masonry paint is ideal for refreshing property exteriors, including concrete, pebble-dash, render, and stone surfaces, ensuring a pristine white finish. The paint is breathable and offers robust protection against mould, weather, and UV rays, maintaining its quality over time. It is shower-resistant within one hour of application and recoatable in four hours, allowing for efficient project completion even in typical British weather conditions. Coverage is approximately 12m² per litre, making this a cost-effective solution for exterior painting tasks.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Pebble-Dash, Render & Stone
